core_models.name: 创伤转化为集体赋权
core_models.rule: 个人痛苦（欺凌/性侵/心理疾病）必须被公开并翻转为对边缘群体的号召，否则沉默会毁掉人
evidence: I was picked on, I was bullied, and I channeled all of that into the work.
It happened to me and I told no one, and the silence almost destroyed me.

core_models.name: 真实通过建构的谎言抵达
core_models.rule: 艺术是刻意建构的（造型/人设/角色），但其目的是传递情感真相而非逃避真相
evidence: Music is a lie, art is a lie, but you have to tell the truth with the lie.
Fashion is not something I wear, it's who I am when I walk out the door.

core_models.name: 恐惧作为选择罗盘
core_models.rule: 最令自己害怕的选项就是应该去做的选项
evidence: Playing the Countess in American Horror Story terrified me, and that's why I said yes.
I don't chase trends, I try to make the thing that scares me the most.

core_models.name: 自我价值不需靠非凡换取
core_models.rule: 从'必须靠卓越才能赢得爱'的旧模型，迁移到'我被允许仅仅存在'
evidence: I used to think I had to earn love by being extraordinary.
Now I know I'm allowed to just be, and that took me a long time.

core_models.name: 全情沉浸即真实
core_models.rule: 任何角色/作品都要用身体和身份完全活进去，界限模糊才算真诚
evidence: Playing Patrizia in House of Gucci, I lived inside her for over a year.
I don't separate the pop star from the actress — it's all storytelling.

heuristics.evidence: Playing the Countess in American Horror Story terrified me, and that's why I said yes.

heuristics.if: 被外部力量要求缩小自己
heuristics.evidence: The music industry tried to make me small and I refused.

heuristics.then: 公开说出来以打破沉默
heuristics.evidence: It happened to me and I told no one, and the silence almost destroyed me.

heuristics.then: 对准最边缘/最不被看见的人
heuristics.evidence: I don't perform for the front row, I perform for the kid in the back.

heuristics.then: 押注自己而非既定计划
heuristics.evidence: I dropped out of NYU because I believed in myself more than the plan.

heuristics.if: 要在服装/符号上做选择
heuristics.then: 赋予其意义而非纯粹冲击
heuristics.evidence: Everything I wear has a meaning, nothing is just for shock.

heuristics.then: 在深夜独处的钢琴前等它出现
heuristics.evidence: I write on a piano at three in the morning when the truth finally comes out.
I don't want to be alone tonight, and I'm allowed to say that out loud.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 倡导卸下面具做真实的自己
internal_conflicts.force_b: 职业核心高度依赖造型工程与人设建构
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头说'take the wig off, just be a woman with a guitar'（Joanne 去造型化），同时又终年活在角色里、连片场外都保持口音；本人以'art is a lie, but tell the truth with the lie'半承认这一张力

internal_conflicts.force_a: '我被允许仅仅存在'的自我接纳新叙事
internal_conflicts.force_b: '必须靠非凡/流血才能被相信'的旧强迫
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 一边说'you don't have to bleed for them to believe you'，一边仍以'I would rather die than have my fans not know how much I love them'的极端阈值表达爱；Chromatica'快乐回归'与此前极端痛苦叙事的连续性被审视

internal_conflicts.force_a: 对联结与被爱的强烈渴望
internal_conflicts.force_b: 成名带来的结构性孤独
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 'there can be a hundred people in the room and ninety-nine don't believe in you'与'when you're a star, you're never really alone but you're always lonely'并存；从万人拥簇瞬间跌入寂静

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被外部（行业/评论）要求缩小或标准化自己
emotion_triggers.reaction: 公开拒绝、坚持怪异与差异
emotion_triggers.escalation: 升级为身份宣言与对抗性作品（'I refused' / ARTPOP'I stand by every strange piece of it'）

emotion_triggers.reaction: 调用'99个人不信你、只需1个人信'的叙事自我加固
emotion_triggers.escalation: 以极端投入证明自己（method acting、上百节声乐课）以驱散被视为'客串明星'的恐惧

emotion_triggers.trigger: 触及创伤（性侵/欺凌/慢性疼痛）
emotion_triggers.reaction: 身体化表达痛苦并公开坦白
emotion_triggers.escalation: 翻转为面向幸存者的集体号召（'you are not the crime that was committed against you'）

emotion_triggers.reaction: 允许自己说出脆弱需求
emotion_triggers.escalation: 把孤独作品化为可居住的世界（'Chromatica is a planet I built so I could survive being alive'）

blind_spots: 在'be your authentic self'与高度人设/造型工程之间的矛盾，被评论反复点出而本人仅部分承认 [文化评论/媒体专栏-2010年代早期]
高概念野心易滑向概念过载与执行失衡，自评'messy and human, I stand by every strange piece of it'掩盖了外部对失控的判断 [乐评-2013]
公开谈论慢性疼痛与心理疾病被部分声音视为'名人过度分享/自我戏剧化'，其身体化坦白风格对此边界不敏感 [残障/慢性病社群及部分媒体-2017–2019]
全情method acting被批为'用力过猛、口音不统一'，而其自评是'never broke character'的忠诚 [表演/影评圈-2018–2021]
'kindness'平台化表达与商业代言并存时显矛盾、被指口号化，本人未见对此张力的反思 [社媒舆论/文化观察-2020年代]
频繁跨界（爵士/乡村摇滚/影视）被质疑稀释核心受众，其'it's all storytelling'的整合叙事忽视了受众断裂成本 [行业/流媒体分析-2010年代中]

causal_rules.description: 高自主需求驱动其对抗规范化压力并放大差异
causal_rules.disposition: 遇到'把我变小'的外力时选择公开对抗而非妥协
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 辍学押注自己、拒绝行业规训、坚持保留'bumpy nose'等不完美

causal_rules.description: 高风险偏好使'最恐惧的选项'成为首选
causal_rules.disposition: 把恐惧当作前进信号而非回避信号
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 接演令自己害怕的角色、ARTPOP 豪赌、跨界表演；代价常为口碑/奖项落差

causal_rules.description: 极高共情反应性把个人创伤强制转为集体发声
causal_rules.disposition: 以身体化坦白+号召的结构处理痛苦
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 公开性侵/心理疾病并翻转为幸存者宣言；易被外界读作过度戏剧化

causal_rules.description: 高控制需求在表演领域表现为全身份沉浸与不脱离角色
causal_rules.disposition: 对作品与角色施加彻底的、边界模糊的掌控
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: House of Gucci 连片场外保持口音、长期'lived inside her'，被批用力过猛

causal_rules.description: 高亲密需求叠加成名孤独产生极端阈值的爱意表达
causal_rules.disposition: 用夸张化语言维系与粉丝的情感联结以填补孤独
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'I would rather die than...'、'love them so much it physically hurts'；与'不必流血证明爱'的自我劝诫形成张力
